LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Novice_1: {PAWN} checked in on a settlement the Pride watches over and found everyone still standing.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Novice_2: {PAWN} logged a quiet patrol - a few raiders scattered at the sight of Pride colors, nothing worth a report to the Citadel.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Novice_3: {PAWN} handed out spare medicine to a caravan that had run dry, then moved on before nightfall.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Novice_4: {PAWN} walked the ruins near a settlement, chased off a pack of ferals, and came back with dust in every seam.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Veteran_1: {PAWN} broke a raider blockade holding a settlement hostage and stayed long enough to see the gates reopen.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Veteran_2: {PAWN} tracked down a missing caravan, fought off the slavers who'd taken it, and brought the survivors home.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Veteran_3: {PAWN} spent the trip treating the wounded at an outlying settlement, leaving them better stocked than before.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Veteran_4: {PAWN} came back limping but standing, with two rescued settlers walking behind.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Elite_1: {PAWN} went in alone where a squad would've drawn too much attention, and got everyone out alive.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Elite_2: {PAWN} ran the operation exactly as planned - in, secure the innocent, out before anything organized a response.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Elite_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks in hostile territory and returned with word the Citadel will want to hear.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Elite_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about what happened out there, just handed off the survivors and asked for a debrief later.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Sentinel_1: {PAWN} pushed past the edge of any territory the Pride patrols, looking for anyone left to protect.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Sentinel_2: {PAWN} came back from the deep wastes with a full report and word of a settlement worth the Pride's protection.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Sentinel_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks beyond contact and returned with news that will matter to Elder Lyons himself.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_Lyons_Sentinel_4: {PAWN} walked back into the Citadel looking like the wasteland itself, carrying proof of who was saved out there.
